messages.content: 你能幫我計劃我的一天嗎？我想從我在紐約的家出發，前往波士頓的一個名為「Knight Gambit」的象棋俱樂部。我想要走最快的路線。之後，我想要前往費城的另一個名為「Rook Corner」的象棋俱樂部，同樣要走最快的路線。最後，我想要回家，但這次我想要走最短的路線。你也能提供我兩個象棋俱樂部舉辦活動的詳細資訊嗎？

function.name: chess_club_details_find
function.description: Provides details about a chess club, including location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The name of the chess club.

city.description: The city in which the chess club is located.

event.description: The event hosted by the club.

function.name: route_planner_calculate_route
function.description: Determines the best route between two points. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start.description: The starting point of the journey.

method.description: The method to use when calculating the route (default is 'fastest').

message.reasoning:
The user wants help planning their day with routes and also want detailed info on events at both clubs.

We have tool functions:

1) chess_club_details_find(name:string, city:string, event?string)
2) route_planner_calculate_route(start:string,destination:string,method?)

User says they start from home in New York City. They need route to Knight Gambit in Boston via fastest. Then route to Rook Corner in Philadelphia via fastest. Finally return home but shortest route.

Also provide details about events at each club.

Thus we should call chess_club_details_find twice: one for Knight Gambit in Boston; second for Rook Corner in Philadelphia. Provide event names if known or null.

Then plan routes using route_planner_calculate_route three times: NYC->Boston fast, Boston->Philadelphia fast, Philly->NYC short.

But note: For last leg, they say "return home but this time I want to take the shortest route." So we set method=shortest.

Now produce output summarizing all steps.

Let's do calls accordingly.

First call chess_club_details_find for Knight Gambit, city Boston. We don't know event so leave unspecified maybe pass None? But param optional. We'll just not include event field.

Second call same for Rook Corner, city Philadelphia.

Third call route planner for NYC -> Boston fastest.

Fourth call route planner for Boston -> Philadelphia fastest.

Fifth call route planner for Philadelphia -> NYC shortest.

Return results as JSON array.

We'll format like earlier examples: an array of objects with type and arguments.

Ok let's craft.
